target_customer: DevOps, SRE and operations teams managing alerts across many monitoring tools
problem: Teams get thousands of alerts from many monitoring systems and suffer alert fatigue. Keep gives one view of alerts, enriches them, correlates them and automates workflows.
business_model: Open source core with paid enterprise tier (AI alert correlation) and cloud
product_category: Open source AIOps and alert management

founders.name: Tal Borenstein
founders.background_notes: Previously an engineering manager leading software teams for SaaS products per YC page.

founders.name: Shahar Glazner
founders.background_notes: Described as a builder and long distance runner on the YC page.

founders.name: Matvey Kukuy
founders.background_notes: Former Grafana director of engineering who joined later per Keep's blog.

competitors.name: Prometheus Alertmanager
competitors.what: Open source alert routing for Prometheus, the comparison Keep used at launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Building integrations with dozens of monitoring tools plus correlation and workflow logic is standard engineering with many integration details.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code and a long list of integrations is replicable. Community and workflow definitions give mild switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Elastic announced its intent to acquire Keep on 2025-05-07 and completed it around 2025-05-20 to 2025-05-21, adding AI workflow automation to its observability and security products.

market_need_then: Alert fatigue across fragmented monitoring stacks was a known pain, and enterprise AIOps tools like BigPanda and Moogsoft existed but had no open source equivalent.

branding.domain_note: Uses keephq.dev, so the plain keep domain was not used.

identity.logo: A fortress like mark built from parapets, symbolizing strength and security, kept through a later visual refresh
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, practical and community oriented, with a Keepers contributor section.

branding.community_and_virality: At the October 2024 funding announcement Keep cited about 3,000 GitHub stars and a community of 400 members and 60 contributors. Product Hunt launch in September 2023.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear logo and contributor identity with a growing open source community, but modest scale and no evidence of broad press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Keep launched as an open source alternative to Alertmanager and enterprise AIOps tools in early 2023, built community on GitHub and raised a 2.7M pre-seed led by Runa Capital in October 2024. Elastic acquired it in May 2025 to add alert automation, an exit that looks like a strategic buy of a young open source team and product with undisclosed terms.
notes: Funding cross-checked between TechCrunch, Keep's own blog and Runa Capital's portfolio. One aggregator calls the round a 2.5M seed and another lists a YC seed dated June 2023, both unverified. A name on one aggregator investor list is unverified. Exit date: Elastic announced intent 2025-05-07 and completion 2025-05-20 or 21 depending on the outlet. Name origin was said to be discussed in a podcast but the text was not available. Success factor choices are judgments.
